AA79

- Growing from soil under leaf litter on North-facing mixed oak/hickory woodland slope.
- Pileipellis tacky.

- Lamellae crowded, shallow, some occasionally forking on inner 2/3s.
- Smell: fungoid.
- Taste: mild and pleasant.
- Spore Print: white
